## Analysis & Visualizations

[Use code chunks with R and the tidyverse to wrangle data and build visualizations. Explain your thought process before and after each code block.]

```{r}
#| label: analysis-chunk
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

# Load your data or create an example tibble
my_data <- tibble(
  x = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
  y = c(10, 25, 20, 35, 30)
)

# Plot your findings with ggplot2
ggplot(my_data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2c3e50", size = 3) +
  geom_line(color = "#3498db", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Plot Title Describing Key Insight",
    subtitle = "Analysis using tidyverse in R",
    x = "X Variable",
    y = "Y Variable"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
